scope: Isolated visual and local interactive proposal only; application runtime and approved designs remain unchanged.

desktop.workflow: All four approved two-part blocks, their arrows, labels and controls stay in the underlying approved frame.

intermediate.mode: Focused dialog; underlying approved page is inert while open, never permanently compressed.

layout.entry: Header AlBot · AI button; existing AI menu entry also opens the local proposal.
layout.initial_state: Open on wide desktop; collapsed on smaller viewports.

identity.name: AlBot
identity.subtitle: Guida all’applicazione
identity.avatar: Native abstract chat icon; no people, original runtime avatar untouched.

knowledge: Optional sanitized database snapshot; OFF in fixture

visible_scope_note.incident: Questa chat non legge automaticamente l’incidente aperto.
visible_scope_note.home: Questa chat non legge automaticamente la pagina aperta.

access.runtime_chat: Authenticated user with active-tenant AI plugin enabled.
prototype_gates: plugin disabled: hide header/menu entry, close panel, clear transcript, reject open/send
logged out or disabled demo role: hide protected page, close panel, clear transcript, reject open/send
tenant change: sync active tenant and clear local transcript and draft
access.demo_membership: default/laboratorio/defaults are fixture tenants. Non-superuser demo roles have default membership only; this is not a new application authorization rule.

state_contract.close: No frame reload; preserve current underlying page form values, expanded sections and scroll; restore focus to entry.
state_contract.same_tenant_reopen: Keep local displayed transcript for visual continuity; this does not imply provider conversation memory.
state_contract.tenant_change: Clear transcript and composer, then label the newly active tenant.
state_contract.page_change: Load another unchanged approved page snapshot and its illustrative question when default tenant selected.
state_contract.submission: Local deterministic fixture response only; no fetch, backend request, storage write or provider call.
state_contract.unsupported_question: Display honest local preview notice; no fabricated context-dependent answer.
state_contract.keyboard: Escape closes; focused dialog traps Tab; focus returns to entry.
state_contract.review_api: window.CIRAssistantReview is a bounded prototype inspection API, not app permissions or model tools.

visual_parity.suggestions: Exclude current page answer_key, then use first two canonical suggestions.
visual_parity.desktop_header_control: Expand (⤢) and close (×); close retains the underlying page state.
visual_parity.mobile_header_control: Close (×), with return row above identity
visual_parity.composer_action: Nuova domanda clears the local transcript and focuses the composer; Invia adds a local sample response.
visual_parity.context_disclosure: Visible Contesto disclosure supplements knowledge label and page-scope note.

global_interface_switch.status: Existing future implementation contract preserved, not implemented by this prototype.

delivery.standalone: Renderer embeds CSS/JS and replaces ASSETS map only with data URIs; opening final HTML requires no server, CDN or network.
delivery.photo_policy: Reuse approved synthetic cybersecurity hero; no human imagery.
delivery.source_snapshots: Exact approved HTML/CSS/JS text is stored in PAGE_SOURCES; wrapper overrides and assistant entry are applied only to the isolated frame.

verification_limits: Native review boards are not browser screenshots.
Bounded JavaScript checks are not end-to-end browser or accessibility certification.
No Flask, live AI provider, production deployment, image build or promotion is performed.
